utterances.transcript: Hi, um, I'm calling about my order, it hasn't arrived yet.
It's, uh, order number four five two... I think it was placed last week.
Okay great, thank you, that's really helpful.
No, that's all. Thanks so much, bye!
Hello, I have a question about my bill this month.
I was charged twice, I think, for the same thing.
Okay, so it will be refunded? That's good.
Perfect, thank you for your help.
This is the third time I'm calling! The package is still not here.
No, no, I already did that, it doesn't work, it is ridiculous.
I'm really frustrated, I need this today, I am so annoyed.
Fine. Just send it again, please.

observations.observation: Caller escalates quickly when asked to repeat steps already tried.
observations.reasoning: Repeated-contact frustration; skip basic troubleshooting next time.

adaptations.instruction: Open by acknowledging any earlier frustration before moving to the task; keep a calm tone.
adaptations.reason: 2 of the last 5 turns read as angry.

adaptations.instruction: Keep responses brisk and to the point.
adaptations.reason: Speaker talks at a fast pace.
